text:
deploy-bot: Attempted deploy blocked for prod-canary (tag: v2.14.1, commit: a1b2c3d). CI gate failed: integration-tests (3 failures), e2e-suite timed out. See CI dashboard: https://ci.internal/redwood/12345 :warning:
melissa: Ugh, those integration tests again. Which tests? any known flakes?
samir: CI shows failures in `auth-session-expiry.test` and `kv-cache-invalidation.test`. logs: https://ci.internal/logs/12345/failed-tests
jia: Confirming — those two started failing on the same commit in staging earlier today. Might be related to the auth lib bump in this PR.
ram: We had a flaky repro recorded for auth-session-expiry last week but it was intermittent. Not the e2e timeout though.
melissa: Can we rerun just the failing suites before deciding to pin or rollback? If rerun is green we can continue canary. If flaky again, I'd prefer pin to v2.14.0 for this change window.
samir: Agreed. I can trigger a selective re-run. Command: ```/rerun-ci a1b2c3d --only integration-tests,e2e-suite --parallel 2```
deploy-bot: Re-run request queued by samir. CI job id: 12358. ETA ~6m.
ops: Heads-up — if we pin to v2.14.0 we need to update the release notes and coordinate with infra for the canary window at 16:00 PST. Would that block anything customer-facing?
melissa: No customer-facing changes planned in this window. Pinning is low risk. But I'd like to wait for the re-run results before locking. Also create a rollback plan if re-run fails.
jia: If the rerun fails again, propose: 1) pin to v2.14.0, 2) open a hotfix branch for the auth lib revert (branch: hotfix/auth-revert-a1b2), 3) schedule patch release in next change window. Anyone object?
ram: Sounds good. I'll start a quick smoke on staging once rerun finishes.
deploy-bot: CI rerun finished: integration-tests: 2/2 passed, e2e-suite: timed out again (timeout at step 4/12). Overall gate status: FAILED.
melissa: Ok, actionable now. Samir, can you triage the e2e timeout root cause (infra/network vs test flake) within 1 hour? If it's infra, ops may need to widen timeouts. If test flake, we pin.
samir: On it. Kicking off a targeted debug run and grabbing a full node diagnostic. I'll post findings in ~30–45m.
ops: If this becomes infra, we should avoid pinning and instead delay canary until after the maintenance window tonight. That might be safer than rolling back code.
melissa: Decision: put prod-canary on HOLD for now. Action items: 
- melissa: file issue and update release board (GH#6789)
- samir: triage e2e timeout (owner)
- jia: prepare hotfix branch in case pin required
- ram: smoke test staging after triage
- ops: block the 16:00 PST canary if needed
deploy-bot: Canary is ON HOLD for tag v2.14.1 (commit: a1b2c3d). Notifying release channel. :lock:
samir: Quick note — logs show the e2e timeout is failing at `checkout-flow` step and the browser container restarted once. Uploading node diagnostics: https://ci.internal/diag/12358
melissa: Thanks. If container restarts are involved, ops + infra should investigate, then we reconvene. Will follow up in 45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
